extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues: (1) 'species' column had a space variant (' Adelie') and a misspelling ('Chinstarp'), which were corrected using normalize_labels; (2) 'flipper_length_mm' had three negative values (rows 0, 30, 39) that were below the minimum allowed (170), so those rows were excluded; (3) one exact duplicate row (row 28) was removed. After fixes, the analysis shows 30 penguins measured on Biscoe, 13 on Dream, and 5 on Torgersen.
